summary: Completed testing of Product Size Management and Order Tracking features. All 10 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend tests passed - size management in admin, order tracking with timeline, footer support email, cart/checkout size display all working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/orders/statuses returns all 8 statuses (Order Placed, Confirmed, Processing, Packed, Shipped, Out for Delivery, Delivered, Cancelled)
Backend: POST /api/orders/track with valid orderId=KJ20260419123246 and phone=9828438321 returns order details
Backend: POST /api/orders/track with invalid orderId returns 404
Backend: POST /api/orders/track with wrong phone returns 404
Backend: POST /api/orders/track with missing fields returns 422
Backend: POST /api/products with sizes array creates product with sizes, GET verifies persistence
Backend: POST /api/products without sizes creates product with empty sizes array (backward compatible)
Backend: GET /api/products returns sizes field on all products
Backend: PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status with valid status updates order
Backend: PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status with invalid status returns 400
Frontend: /track-order page loads with Order ID and Phone inputs
Frontend: Order tracking with valid credentials shows order details (Order ID, Customer, Phone, Total, Status, Items, Payment, Date)
Frontend: Order tracking shows visual timeline with 7 steps (Order Placed through Delivered)
Frontend: Order tracking with invalid credentials shows error message
Frontend: Order tracking page shows 'Need help?' section with Kridhanijewels@gmail.com email link
Frontend: Footer shows Kridhanijewels@gmail.com with mailto link
Frontend: Footer shows Track Order link pointing to /track-order
Frontend: Admin Products - Add Product modal has Size Management section
Frontend: Admin Products - Quick-add buttons for all 8 default sizes (0, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
Frontend: Admin Products - Adding size shows price input field
Frontend: Admin Products - Custom size input with price works
Frontend: Admin Orders - Expand order shows all 8 status buttons
Frontend: Admin Orders - Clicking status button updates order and shows success toast
Frontend: Product Card - Size selector appears for products with sizes
Frontend: Product Card - Clicking size updates displayed price
Frontend: Cart Page - Shows selected size next to product
Frontend: Checkout Order Summary - Shows size for each item (Qty: 1 | Size: 1)
critical_code_review_comments: SizePrice model correctly defined with size (str) and price (float)
ORDER_STATUSES list has all 8 statuses including Cancelled
Order tracking endpoint validates both orderId and phone for security
Product sizes are optional (empty array default) for backward compatibility
Cart uses cartKey (productId_size) for unique identification of same product with different sizes
Timeline excludes Cancelled status (shows 7 steps) which is correct UX
Admin order status update validates against ORDER_STATUSES list
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Size_Ring product with 3 sizes for testing, then deleted after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product Size Management and Order Tracking features fully implemented and tested. Products can have optional sizes array with individual prices. Cart tracks products by cartKey (productId_size). Order tracking uses POST /api/orders/track with orderId + phone. Admin can update order status to any of 8 statuses. Footer has support email Kridhanijewels@gmail.com and Track Order link. Existing products without sizes work normally (backward compatible).
